name: Question 18
problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ -2\text{i} & \text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operation:

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{2\text{i}}{1+\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$

Question 18

Given the matrix A=[1+i1−i−2ii], find the result of applying to A the following elementary row operation: R2:=R2+2i1+iR1

a
[1+i1−i0i]
b
[0i+2−2ii]
c
[1+i1−i−4ii−2]
d
[1+i1−i4ii+2]
e
[1+i1−i0i+2]
